$comment: GatorBait boards: exact Wix Groups requests for Jarvis. Nothing here has been run. Read-only checks on 2026-09-30 confirmed the live IDs, settings, rules and redirects listed. Run in step order under the active controller; stop on any error.
contractNotes: Update Group: PATCH https://www.wixapis.com/social-groups-proxy/groups/v2/groups/{group.id}; required group.id; writable name, slug, privacyStatus, description (max 20,480), teaser (max 1,000), memberTitle, coverImage, settings. Schema read with ReadFullDocsMethodSchema on 2026-09-30.
Update Group has NO accessRestriction field, so paid-plan gating cannot be set by this API. It is a dashboard step for Brenden.
contentType is a top-level method parameter (PLAIN_TEXT | DRAFTJS | RICH_CONTENT). Live descriptions read back as plain text, so PLAIN_TEXT is sent.
Renaming a PUBLIC or PRIVATE group changes its slug (per the docs).

Settings are sent as the full writable set because the docs do not say whether a partial settings object merges. Live settings also carry fields not in the public schema (allowedToCreatePosts, allowedToCommentPosts, allowedToAddMembers, allowedToCreateEvents); the canary step checks they survive.
groupDetailsChangedPostEnabled is set false in the same call, so the renames and new descriptions do not drop automatic 'group details changed' posts into empty feeds.
Cover images cannot be uploaded through this API (docs: 'You cannot upload your own cover image'). Covers are optional and left out.
There is no public REST endpoint to create feed posts (deploy/dept-ideas/community/evidence/group-contract.json), so pinned welcome posts are made by a staff admin in the Groups UI or app.

group.teaser: Off-topic. Tailgates, road trips, food, music and life as a Gator. No politics, no religion.
group.description: The off-topic board: tailgate recipes, road-trip plans, Gainesville memories, other sports and whatever else is on your mind. Politics and religion stay out; everything else is fair game within the rules.

steps.note: CANARY: run this first, then GET the group and confirm allowedToCreatePosts and allowedToCommentPosts are still ALL_MEMBERS and privacy is unchanged before running the rest.

group.teaser: The main board. Florida football every day: games, coaching, roster and hot takes. Free to read, sign in to post.
group.description: The main GatorBait board. Talk Florida football with fellow Gators: games, coaching, depth chart, transfer portal and the week ahead. Free to read; sign in with your free GatorBait account to post. Game-day talk lives in Game Day Threads, recruiting in Recruiting Central, everything else in The Swamp Lounge.

group.teaser: One thread per game. Opens Tuesday, runs through kickoff and closes after the recap. Live chat runs in The Stands.
group.description: One pinned thread per Florida game. It opens on game week Tuesday with the preview stories, runs through kickoff and closes after the GatorBait recap publishes. During the game, the live chat room, The Stands, opens on the GatorBait homepage; this board keeps the pregame and postgame conversation.

group.teaser: Commitments, visits, offers and the transfer portal. Link your source.
group.description: Florida recruiting and the transfer portal: commitments, decommitments, visits, offers and prospect breakdowns. Link your source for anything that is not public. Deeper intel and staff notes live on The Insider Board for All Access and Gold members.

group.teaser: Florida basketball: SEC play, the NCAA Tournament, recruiting and everything hardwood.
group.description: Florida men's and women's basketball: games, SEC play, NCAA Tournament talk, recruiting and the portal. One pinned thread per game once the season tips off.

group.teaser: Baseball, softball, gymnastics, track, tennis, golf, soccer and volleyball. If it's orange and blue, it's here.
group.description: Every other Florida sport: baseball, softball, gymnastics, track and field, swimming, tennis, golf, soccer, volleyball and lacrosse. One thread per sport per season keeps it easy to follow.

group.name: The Insider Board
group.teaser: The members-only board for All Access and GatorBait Gold. Staff notes, recruiting intel and the real conversation.
group.description: The members-only board for All Access and GatorBait Gold subscribers. GatorBait staff post practice notes, recruiting intel and early reads here first, and members talk Gators without the noise. What's said on The Insider Board stays on The Insider Board.

steps.note: Rename changes the slug from swamp-talk; the old /group/swamp-talk redirect stays harmless. Group stays PRIVATE with admin approval until Brenden connects paid plans.

group.teaser: GatorBait Gold only. Buddy's Porch, game threads with staff and the monthly AMA with Buddy Martin.
group.description: The GatorBait Gold lounge. Every game week, Buddy's Porch collects your questions for Buddy Martin to take on The Buddy Martin Show, staff join the game threads, and Buddy hosts a monthly AMA here. Gold members only.

rules.title: No politics, no religion
rules.description: Keep the Lounge the one place everybody can hang out. Those threads are closed and removed.

rules.title: Argue the take, not the person
rules.description: No personal attacks on players, coaches, staff or other posters. No slurs, no threats.

rules.title: No rumors as fact
rules.description: Injury, recruiting, transfer and legal claims need a link to a published report. If all you have is 'I heard,' say so.

rules.title: No doxxing, no harassment
rules.description: Never post anyone's phone, address, workplace, family or private messages. First offense is removal.

rules.title: Keep paid content paid
rules.description: Do not paste Magazine, Insider Board or Gold Lounge posts into free boards or social media. Link to them instead.

rules.title: No spam, no promo
rules.description: No ticket resale, betting touts, product plugs or link farms. AI spam protection is on, and staff remove spam without notice.

rules.description: Moderators remove posts that break these rules. Repeat problems lose posting rights. Questions go to staff, not the thread.
